verdict.rationale: Subscribing to events via webhooks is a fair question for a self-hosted AI API server, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks for event subscription. The pack covers OpenAI-compatible endpoints, MCP client support, agents, Swagger docs and discovery endpoints, but none of these is a webhook mechanism.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
